newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia Yield Spreads-Corrects against the bloc.
newsitem.headline: Australia Yield Spreads-Corrects against the bloc.

text.p: Australian bond yields succumbed to a mild correction after their recent strong outperformance against the dollar bloc and ahead of a clutch of U.S. data later on Tuesday.
The absence of key local data for the next couple of weeks and no word on monetary policy from the Reserve Bank saw the market take the opportunity to book some profits, analysts said.
The yield curve also flattened after spiking sharply last week after a weak labour force report, which fuelled expectations of another cut in official interest rates.
The U.S. faces CPI, housing starts, industrial production and capacity utilisation for May.

"At this stage you would have to say that the data will probably fall on the right side of the fence and it looks as if the U.S. will pick up again," said Stephen Roberts, chief economist at UBS Australia.
Friday's marked rally in U.S. Treasuries following a benign PPI followed through to Monday's session.
